# Celestial Journal

A Skill Harbor house build for people who follow the sky, and for the honestly curious. Celestial Journal does not predict anything, and it says so in its first line. The dates it works with are astronomy: full and new moons, Mercury and Venus retrogrades, eclipses, all precomputed for 2026-2027 and checkable. The meanings around those dates are tradition, presented as tradition. What the skill adds is the part horoscope apps never do: it keeps score, with you, over time.

It starts by asking what you believe. Moon only? Full Western astrology? Crystals, tarot, Chinese astrology, none of it but intrigued? You pick the modules, your Sun sign (birth time and place only if you want more, and they never leave your device), what you want to track: mood, sleep, relationships, work, rituals, and how you want to be warned. Then your Muse watches the calendar for your sign: an alert a few days before a retrograde starts or on the morning of a full moon, with an invitation to set one thing to observe.

During the period you dictate 30-second journal entries; after it ends, the assistant reads them back and asks for your verdict: resonated, didn't resonate, or in between. Months later it can count from your own journal: "disturbed sleep noted on 4 of your last 6 full moons", as an observation about your notes, never as a cosmic claim. Crystals by sign and birthstones are included as one stated tradition, and your own stones override the table. Free to use under the Skill Harbor House...
